name: long-running
description: Run a long drive as three Claude Code sessions: a communicator that acks every message of the owner's within seconds and writes everything he sees, a coordinator that turns each order into a background agent shipping it end to end while one watcher turns CI, merges, taps and promised times into events, and a meta session that owns every fix to the drive's own tools, skill rewrite and install.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
plugins = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"]
entries = [entry for key, installs in plugins.items() if key.startswith("long-running@") for entry in installs]
if not entries:
    raise SystemExit("drive: the long-running plugin is not installed")
newest = max(entries, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
drive = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "drive")
os.execv(drive, [drive, *sys.argv[1:]])
